AI Suite MCP Security
AI Suite MCP Environment
MCP verbose log
Verbose log active in Production

var/log/aisuite_mcp.log is written in the Production context (mcpLogVerbose). It holds prompts, content snippets and tool arguments of every request. Set mcpLogVerbose to auto or off unless you are debugging: Extension Configuration → AI Suite → MCP → Verbose INFO log.
MCP write mode
AI writes go live

mcpWriteMode is set to live, so MCP clients write straight to the live site instead of a draft workspace that an editor reviews first. Set it back to workspace unless live writes are intended: Extension Configuration → AI Suite → MCP → Write mode.
MCP rate limit
No rate limit per token

mcpRateLimitRequests is 0, so a single access token can send any number of requests. A leaked token or a looping agent is then limited by nothing. Set a limit, the default is 100 requests per minute: Extension Configuration → AI Suite → MCP → Rate limit.
MCP raw HTML
Raw HTML writes allowed

mcpAllowRawHtmlWrite is on, so MCP clients may write HTML and JavaScript into code editor fields, which the frontend renders unfiltered. Switch it off unless an AI really has to maintain such fields: Extension Configuration → AI Suite → MCP → Allow raw HTML.
MCP HTTP Security
HTTP allowed

MCP is configured to accept unencrypted HTTP connections (mcpAllowHttp=1). This exposes Bearer tokens to network interception. Disable this setting in production: Extension Configuration → AI Suite → MCP → Allow HTTP.
MCP CORS Configuration
No CORS origins configured

MCP has no CORS origins configured. In production, this means no CORS headers are sent (same-origin only). If browser-based MCP clients need access, configure allowed origins in Extension Configuration → AI Suite → MCP.
MCP Redirect URI Security
No external redirect URIs configured
Only localhost redirect URIs are allowed for OAuth. To allow external MCP clients, configure allowed redirect URIs in Extension Configuration → AI Suite → MCP.
MCP Security
Configuration looks good
MCP security settings are properly configured.
MCP Session Store
%d stored session file(s)
%1$d session files are stored in %2$s. Stateless MCP clients leave one behind per request. Schedule ai-suite-mcp:cleanup: it removes session files older than %3$d seconds.
Session files in %s are within the expected range. ai-suite-mcp:cleanup keeps them bounded.
MCP Environment
All requirements met
The PHP extensions %s are loaded and the MCP SDK is available.
Requirements missing
The PHP extension(s) %s are missing. The MCP server cannot answer requests until they are installed.

The MCP SDK (logiscape/mcp-sdk-php) cannot be loaded. Composer installations require the package, classic mode installations ship it in Resources/Private/PHP/ComposerVendor of ai_suite_mcp, so an incompletely uploaded extension is the usual cause.
